title: "PCA"
format: html
execute: 
  eval: false
---


```{r}
library("FactoMineR")
```


```{r}
train_uid <- read_csv("data-processed/train_by_uid.csv")
train_uid_pca <- train_uid |> 
    select(-c(uid, is_fraud))
```


```{r}
uid_pca <- PCA(train_uid_pca)
```

Call:
PCA(X = train_uid_pca) 

Eigenvalues
                      Dim.1  Dim.2  Dim.3  Dim.4  Dim.5
Variance             36.891 29.760 21.878 21.061 16.023
% of var.             9.411  7.592  5.581  5.373  4.088
Cumulative % of var.  9.411 17.003 22.584 27.957 32.044

```{r}
pca_contrib <- uid_pca$var$contrib  |> as_tibble(rownames = "feature")
contrib_1 <- pca_contrib  |> select(feature, Dim.1)  |> arrange(desc(abs(Dim.1)))  |> head(5)
contrib_2 <- pca_contrib  |> select(feature, Dim.2)  |> arrange(desc(abs(Dim.2)))  |> head(5)
contrib_3 <- pca_contrib  |> select(feature, Dim.3)  |> arrange(desc(abs(Dim.3)))  |> head(5)
contrib_4 <- pca_contrib  |> select(feature, Dim.4)  |> arrange(desc(abs(Dim.4)))  |> head(5)
contrib_5 <- pca_contrib  |> select(feature, Dim.5)  |> arrange(desc(abs(Dim.5)))  |> head(5)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(
  contrib_1,
  caption = "Highest contributions to Dimension 1"
)

knitr::kable(
  contrib_2,
  caption = "Highest contributions to Dimension 2"
)

knitr::kable(
  contrib_3,
  caption = "Highest contributions to Dimension 3"
)

knitr::kable(
  contrib_4,
  caption = "Highest contributions to Dimension 4"
)

knitr::kable(
  contrib_5,
  caption = "Highest contributions to Dimension 4"
)
```
